unit: B3-B (backend) GREEN: Sign in with Apple token revocation on account deletion, dark flag ENABLE_APPLE_TOKEN_REVOCATION. Worktree C:/Users/SynAckITPC/Documents/AI/sc-s79-b3revoke, branch feature/s79-b3-apple-revoke, base main b965c63b. The implementation follows spec sections 2.1-2.8 and the rulings B1-B14 and GB1-GB12. It is my own code, built to the prototype's design (GB7). New module app/services/apple_siwa_service.py: the flag reader, _siwa_config, _normalise_private_key (binascii.Error and UnicodeDecodeError become ValueError("unparseable private key"), GB5), build_client_secret (ES256, headers kid plus typ None, TTL 300), exchange_authorization_code (single shot) and revoke_refresh_token (at most 2 attempts; retry only on httpx.HTTPError, asyncio.TimeoutError, 429 or 5xx). Every Apple call runs under asyncio.wait_for(_CALL_DEADLINE=6.0) with httpx timeout _HTTP_TIMEOUT=5.0 inside. The seams are _TRANSPORT and _now. The GB4 dotenv hazard is documented in the module docstring and in CLAUDE.md. auth_service gains store_apple_refresh_token (never raises; user-id guard; unverified sub check; upsert(on_conflict=user_id); INFO "[SIWA] stored") and _read_apple_refresh_token. In delete_user_account the order is read, cascade, purge, revoke, auth delete, with the SIWA steps gated by the flag. auth_routes gains SocialLoginRequest.authorization_code with a before-validator (any non-str value becomes None) and the gated store after W3-3. Also: migration 044 and its rollback (B6 GRANT to service_role), the apple row in processors.json and the legal_s78.json fixture (module plus appleid.apple.com), _env_safety (APPLE_SIWA_PRIVATE_KEY), and the 043 test changes E1/E2/E3/E5. CLAUDE.md gains the SESSION 79 flag row, the four variable names and the 044 apply-record note. Running notes are in scratchpad/b3green/NOTES.md.
